title: Anthropic's Claude claws its way towards the top of AI chart • The Register
summary: Anthropic's business software subscriptions grew significantly, partly due to its success in the business market and a shift in preference away from OpenAI, exacerbated by public disagreements and strategic changes in OpenAI's approach to military applications.
sentiment_reason: The growth in Anthropic's subscriptions and its strategic positioning against OpenAI, along with the public's apparent preference for Anthropic's responsible AI stance, contribute to a positive market impact.
